description: This file contains the implementation of the BasicWorkSchedule class, which manages employee work schedules, shifts, and related holiday and workday logic within the OrangeHRM system. It implements the WorkScheduleInterface and utilizes various traits and services for handling employee work shifts, holidays, and configuration.

classes.name: BasicWorkSchedule
classes.description: Implements work schedule logic for employees, including shift times, work days, and holidays, utilizing various services and traits to retrieve and process schedule-related data.

methods.name: getWorkShiftService
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the WorkShiftService instance used for accessing work shift details.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with this work schedule instance.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for this work schedule instance.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Determines the length of the employee's work shift, defaulting to configuration if no specific shift is assigned.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Returns the start and end times for the employee's work shift, either from assigned shift or default.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a non-working day according to the work week schedule.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is marked as a half-day holiday.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Determines if a specific day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific day is a half-day holiday.
